scope: Immutable equal pricing-component sharing, bounded price metadata and streaming category aggregation; exact amounts and current JSON preserved

algorithm.components: Standard HashSet equality across category, count, cost, knownCost, status and rate; Arc sharing never merges request identities or ledger amounts
algorithm.budgets: Component pool at most 4096 entries and 1MiB of component text; entries over 1KiB bypass it; additional bounded structure/table overhead. Separate common text pool at most 4096 entries and 1MiB of UTF-8 text
algorithm.overflow: Keep original fields in full and reuse existing matches; no record truncation or loss
algorithm.aggregation: Four streaming category accumulators replace input-sized reference lists and rate sets; distinct bases, issues and revisions retain their sets, so whole aggregation is not constant space
algorithm.validation: Totals and individual components validate status and exact known/complete amounts, including single-row queries; request-specific basis preserved
algorithm.boundaries: No new DTO or schema, persistence version, migration, compatibility, external execution or dependency
